Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.

Activate Torchling by paying {R}, untapping it.

225-5531-5694-5913-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
225-5531-5694-5913-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Pinnacle Monk and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Pinnacle Monk and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
Repeat steps 6 through 9 once.
Repeat from step 1.
225-5531-5694-5913-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Pinnacle Monk and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

4687-5115-6006.notablePrerequisites: Gemstone Array has at least four counters on it.
4687-5115-6006.description:

Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Gemstone Array, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

Remove a +1/+1 and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.

348-1116-1152-2992-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.

Resolve the Living Lightning trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

Repeat from step 2 using the Pirated Copy token instead.

Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Temporal Manipulation and returning the original Temporal Manipulation to your hand.

When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Pith Driller trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.

Resolve the second trigger, returning Demonic Gifts from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.

Activate Mist-Syndicate Naga's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U} and returning Palinchron from the battlefield to your hand, putting Mist-Syndicate Naga onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

Activate Watcher of the Roost by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Watcher of the Roost's morph ability by revealing a white card from your hand, turning it face up.

Once Cryptic Trilobite has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may remove them for infinite mana, then repeat step 1 to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Marath, which can then be used for Marath's other modes.
